Messages.Author: agzocgud
Messages.Body:
Hello

Reading the text of Static Virtue over and over and have the following
question:

If you play Static Virtue and choose a vampire that was brought into
play prevoius round, do you have to fetch even pairs of aye and orun?

/Mathias

Static Virtue
Type: Master
Requires: laibon
Master. Requires a ready Laibon.
Choose a Laibon you control. If this Laibon was moved to your ready
region during your last influence phase, then for every two capacity
above 4 this Laibon has, you may move one Aye and one Orun from your
hand or library to this Laibon. Otherwise, you may move one Aye or one
Orun from your hand or library to this Laibon. Shuffle afterward.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
agzocgud wrote:
> If you play Static Virtue and choose a vampire that was brought into
> play prevoius round, do you have to fetch even pairs of aye and orun?

Yes.

1 Aye and 1 Orun
or
2 Aye and 2 Orun
or
3 Aye and 3 Orun
etc.
